features.name: center_is_x
features.description: Indicator for whether the center square is occupied by 'x'.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct linear margin for the strategic importance of the center square for 'x'.

features.name: center_is_o
features.description: Indicator for whether the center square is occupied by 'o'.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct linear margin for the strategic importance of the center square for 'o'.

features.name: num_x_corners
features.description: Count of corner squares occupied by 'x'.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates corner control into a continuous severity measure, allowing the linear SVM to weight corner dominance.

features.name: num_o_corners
features.description: Count of corner squares occupied by 'o'.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates corner control into a continuous severity measure, allowing the linear SVM to weight corner dominance.

features.name: num_x_edges
features.description: Count of non-corner edge squares occupied by 'x'.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a linear projection of edge control, which has different strategic value than corners or the center.

features.name: num_o_edges
features.description: Count of non-corner edge squares occupied by 'o'.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a linear projection of edge control, which has different strategic value than corners or the center.

features.name: total_x_count
features.description: Total number of squares occupied by 'x' on the board.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a proxy for the stage of the game and overall board presence, useful as a baseline weight in linear models.
features.formula: np.where(top_left_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(top_middle_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(top_right_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_left_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_middle_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_right_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_left_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_middle_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_right_square == 'x', 1, 0)

features.name: total_o_count
features.description: Total number of squares occupied by 'o' on the board.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a proxy for the stage of the game and overall board presence, useful as a baseline weight in linear models.
features.formula: np.where(top_left_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(top_middle_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(top_right_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_left_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_middle_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_right_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_left_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_middle_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_right_square == 'o', 1, 0)

features.name: x_main_diagonal_score
features.description: Count of 'x' marks on the main diagonal (top-left to bottom-right).
features.expected_model_benefit: Directly measures progress towards a specific winning condition, providing a strong linear signal.

features.name: x_anti_diagonal_score
features.description: Count of 'x' marks on the anti-diagonal (top-right to bottom-left).
features.expected_model_benefit: Directly measures progress towards a specific winning condition, providing a strong linear signal.

features.name: x_potential_lines_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of the number of potential winning lines (rows, columns, diagonals) that 'x' can still complete, considering the current board state.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex non-linear interactions of board state into a single continuous severity measure suitable for linear SVM margins.

features.name: o_threat_level_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of the threat level posed by 'o', based on the number of lines where 'o' has two marks and the third is blank.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a high-level summary of opponent threat, allowing the linear model to adjust its decision boundary based on defensive necessity.
